description: Tavily asynchronous deep research. Submits a research task that the Tavily engine runs in the background (typically 30s-5min), then returns a request_id. Poll tavily_get_research with the request_id to retrieve the synthesized result with full citations.

tools.name: tavily_research
tools.short_description: Start an async deep research task - returns a request_id to poll for results
tools.description: Submit a deep research task to Tavily. The task runs asynchronously (typically 30 seconds to 5 minutes depending on complexity) and Tavily's engine synthesizes information from multiple sources into a cited report. Returns a request_id IMMEDIATELY. You MUST then call tavily_get_research with that request_id to retrieve the result. Use this for in-depth research questions that require synthesizing information from many sources (e.g. 'compare X vs Y', 'summarize the state of Z in 2026'). For simple one-shot lookups, use tavily_search instead.

input.description: The research question or topic. Be specific and detailed. The more context you provide, the better the synthesis.

model.description: Tavily research model tier. 'mini' (fast, cheap, good for most queries) or 'pro' (slower, more thorough, better for complex multi-hop questions).

citation_format.description: Citation format used in the returned report's sources list.

returns.description: Research task submission with request_id to poll via tavily_get_research

tools.name: tavily_get_research
tools.short_description: Poll for the result of an async research task started via tavily_research
tools.description: Poll for the result of an async research task. Pass the request_id returned from tavily_research. If status is 'pending' or 'in_progress', call this tool again after a short delay. When status is 'completed', the result contains the synthesized content and a sources list of citations.

returns.description: Research result with status (pending|completed), synthesized content, and sources list of citations
